content: Succinylsulfathiazole is a sulfonamide compound, also referred to as succinylsulphathiazole. It appears as a white or yellowish-white crystalline powder. This substance is soluble in aqueous solutions containing alkali hydroxides and carbonates but exhibits very limited solubility in water. Pharmacologically, it is categorized as an ultra-long-acting drug. Approximately 95% of the administered drug remains localized in the gastrointestinal tract, while only about 5% undergoes slow hydrolysis to form sulfathiazole, which is then absorbed systemically. The primary therapeutic application of succinylsulfathiazole is its antibacterial effect within the gastrointestinal tract. The recommended dosage ranges from 10 grams to 20 grams per day, administered in divided doses.
